verdict.rationale: The skill ships as a plain folder in the open Agent Skills format: a SKILL.md plus dependency-free Python tools. It can be installed by manually copying that folder or by running a packaging script, so a reviewer could inspect the instructions and scripts from the public repo before and after installing. However, nothing documents a pre-install content listing or file manifest, and nothing shows the /plugin marketplace install path offering a preview or review step. Missing for 10: documented pre-install file listing or manifest, review or preview step in the plugin install flow, explicit guidance on auditing the bundled scripts.
